Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying funding for local government passenger ferry service.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to local government passenger ferry servicefunding; amending RCW 47.60.645; adding a new section to chapter 47.60RCW; adding a new section to chapter 47.66 RCW; and creating newsections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By August 1st, November 1st, February 1st, and May 1st of everyyear, the department of transportation shall notify the state treasurerin writing of the amount of state sales and use tax paid under chapters82.08 and 82.12 RCW by the Washington state ferries on the purchase offuel for the preceding calendar quarter. By September 1st, December1st, March 1st, and June 1st of every year, the state treasurer shalltransfer an amount equal to the amount indicated by the department intheir notification to the treasurer into the passenger ferry accountcreated in RCW 47.60.645.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.60.645 and 1995 2nd sp.s. c 14 s 558 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There is hereby established in the transportation fund thepassenger ferry account. Money in the account shall be used for: (1)Grants for ferry systems operated by local governments; and (2) capitalimprovements for local government passenger ferry projects including,but not limited to, pedestrian and transit facilities at ferryterminals and passengeronly ferry vessels. Moneys in the accountshall be expended with legislative appropriation.
The indication of the amount of fuel taxespaid by the Washington state ferries in section 1 of this act appliesto all calendar quarters beginning on or after April 1, 2006.

(1) By April 1, 2007, the department shallsell or otherwise dispose of the Washington state ferries Snohomish andChinook for market value and deposit the proceeds of the sales into thepassenger ferry account established under RCW 47.60.645. (2) By April 1, 2007, the department shall sell or otherwisedispose of the Washington state ferries Skagit and Kalama for marketvalue or offer the ferries as a grant to a Washington state publictransportation benefit area or county for use on a ferry systemoperated by the recipient. Proceeds from the sale of the ferries shallbe deposited in the passenger ferry account established under RCW47.60.645.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.66 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the grants provided in RCW 47.60.645, thedepartment shall establish a local government ferry grant programsubject to availability of amounts appropriated for this specificpurpose. (2) In providing grants under this section, the department mayenter into multiple year contracts with stipulation that future yearallocations are subject to the availability of funding as provided bylegislative appropriation. (3) Priority shall be given to grant applications that providecontinuity of existing passengeronly service and the provision of SB 6787 p. 2 local or federal matching funds.
